meta.name: strategic-alliances
meta.description: Structures partnerships that change what the business can do — technology integrations, channel and reseller arrangements, joint ventures, and OEM relationships. Use this to evaluate or structure a strategic partnership, decide between partnering and building, negotiate commercial terms of an alliance, or diagnose a partnership that is signed but not producing. For audience-borrowing partnerships, use `marketing:partnership-marketing`.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估、构建并落地能让企业能力升级的战略合作
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正考虑用技术、渠道或合资伙伴扩展业务,却不确定如何评估和谈判。
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate and land strategic partnerships that expand what your business can do

howto.what: 按一套固定流程拆解战略合作：先判合作、自建还是收购，再明确双方各自想要什么；用排他性、分成、路线图承诺、数据、客户归属、终止与交接这些条款来设计协议，并诊断签约后不产出的原因。
howto.when: 当你提出要评估或设计战略合作（如技术集成、渠道分销、合资/OEM 等）、在自研与合作之间取舍、谈合同条款，或排查已签约但没产出的合作时触发；纯借对方受众的合作不归它管。

say.text: 帮我判断：这个能力该自研，还是找伙伴合作？
say.note: 会按“伙伴/自建/收购”的判断来做推演。

say.text: 跟对方签了合作协议但始终没产出，帮我看看卡在哪。
say.note: 会按四种典型停滞原因逐项排查。

say.text: 我们准备给渠道独家授权，谈判前该注意哪些条款？
say.note: 会提醒独家权要限时、并设可终止它的业绩底线。

howto.what_en: Uses a fixed process for strategic alliances: choose partner/build/buy; clarify each side's wants; review exclusivity, economics, roadmap, data, customer ownership and exit; diagnose signed partnerships that are not producing.
howto.when_en: Triggers when asked to evaluate or structure a strategic partnership, choose partner vs build, negotiate alliance terms, or diagnose a signed partnership that is producing nothing.

say_en.text: Should we build this capability in-house or partner with another company?
Our signed partnership isn't producing results. Diagnose what's wrong.
We're about to grant channel exclusivity. What terms should we insist on?
say_en.note: Flags time-boxing and an ending performance floor.
